'''[[Kurask]]''' can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] by various medium and high levelled Slayer masters upon reaching 70 [[Slayer]] and 65 [[combat level]].

Kurask are found in the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]], the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]] after completing [[Song of the Elves]], and in the [[Kurask Lair]] on [[Laguna Aurorae]] with 58 [[Sailing]]. In the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, there is also a separate task-only area. There are two 3D models for kurask, normal and big, but this is merely a cosmetic difference as there is no difference in stats. 

Kurask attack with somewhat inaccurate crush attacks that can hit up to 11. [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all their damage. For players with at least 75 [[Defence]], there is a viable strategy to not pray against them, and instead collect their bones and occasionally cast [[Bones to Peaches]] (unlocked from the [[Mage Training Arena]]) to restore health at a significantly lower cost at the expense of moderately more attention required.

The [[king kurask]] is the [[Superior slayer monster|superior]] version of the kurask unlocked with [[Bigger and badder]].  It has no special mechanics, but is significantly more accurate and has a max hit of 33. If players are using the Bones to Peaches strategy, it is advised to turn on Protect from Melee and bring at least one [[prayer potion]] in case the superior spawns.

They are weakest to stab, ranged, and magic attacks, but similarly to [[turoth]], kurask have the [[Leafy (attribute)|leafy]] attribute, meaning they can only be damaged with [[leaf-bladed weapons]] (the [[leaf-bladed sword]], [[Leaf-bladed battleaxe|battleaxe]], and [[Leaf-bladed spear|spear]]), [[broad-tipped ammunition]] ([[broad bolts]] and [[Broad arrows|arrows]]), or the spell [[Magic Dart]]. All other weapons, spells, and other sources of damage, including [[Dwarf multicannon|cannons]] and [[Thrall|thralls]], will ''not'' deal any damage. However, the special attacks of the [[Saradomin godsword]], [[ancient godsword]], and [[toxic blowpipe]] ''will'' heal the player as if the attack performed its rolled damage. The set effect of [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's equipment]] will ''not'' activate. The [[Burning claws|Burning Claws]] special attack will not deal damage but it does apply burn. 

Kurask can be a profitable task, as they frequently drop weapons and armour suitable for [[High Level Alchemy]], as well as the requisite [[Nature rune|nature runes]]. Players should bring an [[herb sack]] as kurask always drop three herbs when they roll the [[herb drop table]]. They also drop [[seeds]], worthwhile quantities of [[coins]], and valuable noted stacks of [[white berries]], [[big bones]], [[Coconut|coconuts]], and [[papaya fruit]]. Kurask in the Iowerth Dungeon also additionally drop [[Crystal shard|crystal shards]]. King Kurask there will always drop crystal Shards.

Melee =
Kurasks are weakest to stab, although slash is still better with the leaf-bladed battleaxe due to it having a much higher max hit.

Praying [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all damage from kurasks. If players have [[Bigger and Badder]] unlocked, [[king kurask]] may spawn during kurask tasks, but have no additional mechanics.
